title: Retraction Dates
text:
When where papers retracted? see @retraction-scatterplot.


Code
import pandas
import os

datafolder = "retraction-watch-data/"
csvfile = "retraction_watch.csv"

df = pandas.read_csv(os.path.join(datafolder, csvfile))

df.dropna(subset=['RetractionDate', 'OriginalPaperDate'], inplace=True)

df.head()
df['RetractionDate'] = pandas.to_datetime(df['RetractionDate'], format='mixed')
df['OriginalPaperDate'] = pandas.to_datetime(df['OriginalPaperDate'], format='mixed')

df.dropna(subset=['RetractionDate', 'OriginalPaperDate']).plot.scatter('OriginalPaperDate', 'RetractionDate', alpha=0.2, grid=True)

title: Retraction Watch Data Explorer
text:
import pandas
import os

datafolder = "retraction-watch-data/"
csvfile = "retraction_watch.csv"


df = pandas.read_csv(os.path.join(datafolder, csvfile))


df.columns

Index(['Record ID', 'Title', 'Subject', 'Institution', 'Journal', 'Publisher',
       'Country', 'Author', 'URLS', 'ArticleType', 'RetractionDate',
       'RetractionDOI', 'RetractionPubMedID', 'OriginalPaperDate',
       'OriginalPaperDOI', 'OriginalPaperPubMedID', 'RetractionNature',
       'Reason', 'Paywalled', 'Notes', 'Unnamed: 20'],
      dtype='str')



df['RetractionDate'] = pandas.to_datetime(df['RetractionDate'])
df['OriginalPaperDate'] = pandas.to_datetime(df['OriginalPaperDate'])


df.dropna(subset=['RetractionDate', 'OriginalPaperDate']).plot.scatter('OriginalPaperDate', 'RetractionDate', alpha=0.2, grid=True)
